title: Eagles - Hotel California
source: Ultimate Guitar official chord chart (user-supplied PDF)
notes: AUDIO NOT YET SUPPLIED - this truth file is ready, the mp3 is not. Nothing has been scored against it.
Zero power chords, so like Empty Rooms any '5' emitted is wrong.

Contains a genuine dominant seventh (F#7) that recurs throughout - the only real-song test of the CD-5 seventh gate we have. F# also appears as a plain major triad in the same song, so this song tests BOTH directions of that gate: F# must not become F#7, and F#7 must not become F#.
Progression is Bm F# A E / G D Em F#7 - eight distinct chords, richer than either other chart.

Also the reference case for BT-03b key detection: the song is B minor but Bm is the RAREST chord in the loop, so 'most frequent root' fails and profile correlation is required. Detected key should read B minor.
Distinct roots: B, F#, A, E, G, D - six.
